description: Query and transform JSON using jq expressions. Accepts a file path or raw JSON string. Returns parsed, structured output — far more compact than reading a full JSON file. The filter is passed directly to jq (no shell), so shell-style escaping such as backslash-escaped quotes is neither needed nor supported — write the filter exactly as jq expects it.

input.description: Raw JSON string to process (alternative to file)

rawOutput.description: Output raw strings without JSON encoding (-r)

name: jq
title: jq JSON processor
